anchor.classification: Franchisee sales grow by comparable sales × new-unit sales contribution × FX. Rent, royalties and initial fees are corporate revenue; systemwide sales are franchisee plus company sales, without adding rent or royalties again. Restaurant counts are a separate illustration. First-row revenue is H2 only; growth compares H1 actual plus H2 forecast with FY2025, then full years.

warnings: McDonald’s dated core operating study: June 30, 2026 capital and discount origin, informed by October 19 research including September NEXT plans. This is not an ex-ante June view, current price target, current upside estimate or funding certification. Unpriced claims remain unknown until an explicit conditional policy is selected.

A mature franchisor with global rent and royalty income, company-operated restaurants and substantial real-estate reinvestment. Separate bear, base and bull annual FCFF paths retain NEXT support costs. Operating EV is available first; common-share illustrations require six explicit capital assumptions. No scenario probabilities are assigned.

Franchisee sales grow by comparable sales × new-unit sales contribution × FX. Rent, royalties and initial fees are corporate revenue; systemwide sales are franchisee plus company sales, without adding rent or royalties again. Restaurant counts are a separate illustration. First-row revenue is H2 only; growth compares H1 actual plus H2 forecast with FY2025, then full years.

Core EBIT excludes equity-method ownership earnings and recurring property-disposal gains. It retains ordinary other costs, restructuring and full SBC economic cost within SGA. H2 contribution reconciles the full-year forecast to observed H1; FY2026 restructuring cannot fall below the observed $98m. Generic margin edits are explicit aggregate operating assumptions.

FCFF = core EBIT × (1 − cash tax) + consolidated D&A − cash capex − new finance-lease assets − Δ operating working capital. Editable net investment is capex plus finance-lease investment and working capital less D&A; edits are separate analyst adjustments, never invented source components. H2 finance-asset additions and working-capital seasonality are assumptions.

Operating leases remain operating expenses: do not subtract operating-lease liabilities or add operating ROU assets. Finance-lease assets incur economic investment; existing finance claims need a separate explicit amount. June combined lease liabilities are $14,729m, but the finance split is unknown. No separate real-estate asset is stacked on modeled operations.

NEXT rent relief reduces revenue and EBIT once; capital support enters cash capex once. Base 2027–2030 support totals $5bn: $1.75bn capital plus $3.25bn rent relief. A further $3.5bn through 2036 and its 35%/65% split are explicit assumptions. Bear support costs are 20% higher. Do not deduct the program again as a capital claim.

H2 2026 and ten full years through 2036 are fixed: 11 buckets span 10.5 discount years. The 2037 terminal removes finite NEXT relief and uses normalized NOPAT × (1 − g / ROIC), including economic finance-asset reinvestment. Annual WACCs compound over a half year then full years. Terminal margin is before finite rent relief. No generic horizon extension or capital normalization is applied.

June cash is $822m, debt $39,863m and exact common shares 707,641,531. Finance leases, affiliate equity, other assets, minimum cash, incremental existing awards and other claims require explicit amounts. Affiliate ownership value excludes royalty rights already in core EV; existing awards exclude future SBC cash replacement. Cash below the reserve produces a deduction, not a zero floor.

Conditional common allocation does not certify refinancing, mandatory payments, dividends or buybacks. FY2025 CFO less capex exceeded dividends/buybacks by $15m; H1 2026 was $185m short before other flows. Debt classifications are already included once. No current capital roll-forward, current quote or supported current-target admission is available.

FY2016–2025 history uses the latest filed comparatives within the cutoff, not ex-ante vintages. GAAP EBIT includes ownership earnings, disposal gains and unusual items excluded or normalized in the core forecast. Refranchising, China/Hong Kong deconsolidation, COVID and 2019 lease accounting limit comparability. CFO less capex is levered FCF, not FCFF. Missing data stays null.

WACC, normalized tax, terminal growth and incremental ROIC are editable analyst scenarios, not market-calibrated estimates. Bear/base/bull WACC is 9.5%/8%/7%; terminal growth 2%/2.5%/3%; incremental ROIC 13%/18%/22%.

Normalized cash-tax rates do not extrapolate discrete H1 benefits or appraise every jurisdiction. No deferred-tax asset or speculative refund is added. Unresolved legal and tax claims require a non-overlapping explicit allocation policy.

Simulation is manual and operating-EV only. Fixed initial uncertainty is uncalibrated; every trial uses the same dated annual engine, half-year discounting and terminal normalization. Claims are not jointly sampled, so equity and per-share distributions remain unavailable even after an explicit deterministic illustration. Current target and upside remain unknown.

sourceInputs.units: USD millions; rates decimals; exact common shares raw count
sourceInputs.not_ex_ante: October information, including September NEXT targets, informs cash flows discounted to June capital date. This is deliberately not an ex-ante June appraisal or an October target.

observed_h1_2026.definition: core contribution = GAAP EBIT 6292 minus other operating income 106. Strips all equity earnings, property/refranchising gains, and charges in that line. H2 separately bears modeled ongoing expense and remaining restructuring.

policies.operating_leases: Rent remains in operating expense; do not subtract operating lease liabilities or add operating ROU assets to EV.
policies.finance_leases: Consolidated D&A including finance ROU amortization is added back; modeled new finance ROU asset additions are economic capex. Finance debt must be explicitly supplied in allocation; June split is unknown. Do not subtract finance lease principal in FCFF again.
policies.affiliate_interests: All equity earnings excluded from operating forecasts. Affiliate royalties remain operating revenue. Ownership stakes valued separately only under explicit allocation policy; no dividends or equity income included in core FCFF.
policies.sbc: Full economic SBC stays in SGA as cash replacement. No SBC addback, mechanical future share dilution, or buyback-funded EPS uplift. Additional award reserve must cover only incremental existing claims not already charged via future compensation.
policies.next: Rent relief reduces rent revenue and EBIT exactly once. Capital support appears in cash capex exactly once. Remaining 2031–36 support is explicit. The 2037 terminal year removes the finite support but requires g/ROIC economic reinvestment.
policies.terminal: Terminal NOPAT = normalized 2036 EBIT without NEXT relief × (1+g) × (1-tax). FCFF = terminal NOPAT × (1-g/ROIC). No second capex/D&A/NWC deduction in terminal. Ongoing $50–100m restructuring-like expense persists through terminal.
policies.tax: Normalized cash-tax proxy, not a forecast of each jurisdiction or a reuse of one-off discrete H1 tax benefits. No separate deferred-tax asset added.
policies.cashflow_timing: Remaining H2 2026 is valued at 0.5 years; 2027–2036 at 1.5–10.5 years (year-end convention). H2 EBIT/DA/cash-capex deduct observed H1. H2 finance additions and NWC are explicitly estimated; no fictitious observed H1 finance capex.
policies.capex: Forecast full investment in corporate real estate/equipment plus economic finance-lease assets. Excludes franchisees own capex; no systemwide restaurant assets added to bridge.
policies.units: Store-count growth is a separate illustration, not multiplied into sales after the explicit unit-sales contribution. Sales use comp × unit contribution × FX.

sourceOutput.status: Dated conditional analyst scenarios, not a current price target; v1 independent review complete, v2 targeted recheck pending

bear.scope: Consolidated royalty/rent/company-restaurant operating EV; excludes separately valued equity-method ownership interests; operating leases treated as operating; finance-lease financing separate
bear.allocation_status: blocked until explicit complete capital/award policy is supplied

base.scope: Consolidated royalty/rent/company-restaurant operating EV; excludes separately valued equity-method ownership interests; operating leases treated as operating; finance-lease financing separate
base.allocation_status: blocked until explicit complete capital/award policy is supplied

bull.scope: Consolidated royalty/rent/company-restaurant operating EV; excludes separately valued equity-method ownership interests; operating leases treated as operating; finance-lease financing separate
bull.allocation_status: blocked until explicit complete capital/award policy is supplied

policy.basis: Analyst illustration only. June finance lease claim assumed $2.5bn (not disclosed June split); affiliate equity $4.4bn (Japan June quoted stake $2.161bn plus assumed China/other equity); $0.8bn operating cash; $1bn incremental existing-award reserve after excluding cash replacement charged in SGA; $1bn other claim reserve. No fairness or completeness certification, no assumption of exact grant-level allocation.

Analyst sensitivity policy lower_claims_higher_assets, USD millions; not verified June fair values. Finance lease claim assumed 2000, informed by December liability 2352 with June split unknown. Affiliate equity assumed 6000, including Japan's June quoted stake 2161 and assumed China/other ownership values; royalty rights remain in operating EV. Other nonoperating assets assumed 0. Minimum operating cash assumed 500; any reserve above cash 822 reduces equity without clipping. Existing-award incremental claim assumed 500, excluding future SBC cash replacement already charged in SGA and already-issued shares. Other noncommon claims assumed 500, only for amounts not already captured in forecast taxes, compensation, operating liabilities, debt or leases. These chosen sensitivity amounts are neither confidence bounds, grant-level valuations, nor completeness or funding certifications.

Analyst sensitivity policy higher_claims_lower_assets, USD millions; not verified June fair values. Finance lease claim assumed 3000, informed by December liability 2352 with June split unknown. Affiliate equity assumed 3000, including Japan's June quoted stake 2161 and assumed China/other ownership values; royalty rights remain in operating EV. Other nonoperating assets assumed 0. Minimum operating cash assumed 1500; any reserve above cash 822 reduces equity without clipping. Existing-award incremental claim assumed 1500, excluding future SBC cash replacement already charged in SGA and already-issued shares. Other noncommon claims assumed 2000, only for amounts not already captured in forecast taxes, compensation, operating liabilities, debt or leases. These chosen sensitivity amounts are neither confidence bounds, grant-level valuations, nor completeness or funding certifications.

scope.zh-Hans: 麦当劳注明日期的核心经营研究：资本基准和折现起点为 2026 年 6 月 30 日，采用截至 10 月 19 日的研究及 9 月 NEXT 计划。此研究不是当时已知的六月观点、当前目标价、当前上涨空间估计或资金充足认证。未定价索偿权保持未知，直至明确选择条件政策。

summary.en: A mature franchisor with global rent and royalty income, company-operated restaurants and substantial real-estate reinvestment. Separate bear, base and bull annual FCFF paths retain NEXT support costs. Operating EV is available first; common-share illustrations require six explicit capital assumptions. No scenario probabilities are assigned.
summary.zh-Hans: 成熟的特许经营商，拥有全球租金与特许权收入、自营餐厅及大量房地产再投资。熊市、基准与牛市年度 FCFF 路径分别保留 NEXT 支持成本。先提供经营企业价值；每股条件示例需六项明确资本假设。未赋予情景概率。

growth.en: Franchisee sales grow by comparable sales × new-unit sales contribution × FX. Rent, royalties and initial fees are corporate revenue; systemwide sales are franchisee plus company sales, without adding rent or royalties again. Restaurant counts are a separate illustration. First-row revenue is H2 only; growth compares H1 actual plus H2 forecast with FY2025, then full years.
growth.zh-Hans: 特许经营销售额按同店增长 × 新店销售贡献 × 汇率变化推算。租金、特许权费及初始费用属于公司收入；全系统销售额为加盟店加自营店销售额，不再重复加入租金或特许权费。餐厅数量仅另作示例。首行收入仅为下半年；增长比较上半年实际加下半年预测与 2025 全年，随后比较完整年度。

profitability.en: Core EBIT excludes equity-method ownership earnings and recurring property-disposal gains. It retains ordinary other costs, restructuring and full SBC economic cost within SGA. H2 contribution reconciles the full-year forecast to observed H1; FY2026 restructuring cannot fall below the observed $98m. Generic margin edits are explicit aggregate operating assumptions.
profitability.zh-Hans: 核心 EBIT 排除权益法所有权收益及经常性资产处置收益，保留普通其他费用、重组费用和销售管理费用中的完整股份薪酬经济成本。下半年贡献将全年预测与已报告上半年衔接；2026 全年重组费用不得低于已报告的 9800 万美元。通用利润率编辑属于明确的汇总经营假设。

capital.en: FCFF = core EBIT × (1 − cash tax) + consolidated D&A − cash capex − new finance-lease assets − Δ operating working capital. Editable net investment is capex plus finance-lease investment and working capital less D&A; edits are separate analyst adjustments, never invented source components. H2 finance-asset additions and working-capital seasonality are assumptions.
capital.zh-Hans: FCFF = 核心 EBIT ×（1 − 现金税率）+ 合并折旧摊销 − 现金资本支出 − 新增融资租赁资产 − 经营营运资本增加。可编辑净投资为资本支出加融资租赁投资与营运资本增加，减折旧摊销；编辑单独列为分析者调整，不伪装为来源数据。下半年融资租赁资产增加及营运资本季节性属于假设。

leases.en: Operating leases remain operating expenses: do not subtract operating-lease liabilities or add operating ROU assets. Finance-lease assets incur economic investment; existing finance claims need a separate explicit amount. June combined lease liabilities are $14,729m, but the finance split is unknown. No separate real-estate asset is stacked on modeled operations.
leases.zh-Hans: 经营租赁保留为经营费用，不扣除经营租赁负债，也不加入经营使用权资产。融资租赁资产计入经济投资；既有融资租赁索偿权需另行明确金额。六月合计租赁负债为 147.29 亿美元，但融资租赁拆分未知。不在已建模经营价值上另加房地产价值。

next.en: NEXT rent relief reduces revenue and EBIT once; capital support enters cash capex once. Base 2027–2030 support totals $5bn: $1.75bn capital plus $3.25bn rent relief. A further $3.5bn through 2036 and its 35%/65% split are explicit assumptions. Bear support costs are 20% higher. Do not deduct the program again as a capital claim.
next.zh-Hans: NEXT 租金减免仅一次降低收入与 EBIT；资本支持仅一次计入现金资本支出。基准 2027–2030 支持合计 50 亿美元：资本 17.5 亿及租金减免 32.5 亿。至 2036 年另有 35 亿美元及其 35%/65% 拆分均属明确假设。熊市支持成本高 20%。不得在资本索偿权中再次扣除该计划。

terminal.en: H2 2026 and ten full years through 2036 are fixed: 11 buckets span 10.5 discount years. The 2037 terminal removes finite NEXT relief and uses normalized NOPAT × (1 − g / ROIC), including economic finance-asset reinvestment. Annual WACCs compound over a half year then full years. Terminal margin is before finite rent relief. No generic horizon extension or capital normalization is applied.
terminal.zh-Hans: 固定为 2026 下半年及至 2036 年的十个完整年度：11 个区间跨 10.5 个折现年。2037 终值移除有限期 NEXT 减免，采用正常化 NOPAT ×（1 − g / ROIC），包含融资租赁资产经济再投资。年度 WACC 先按半年再按完整年度复利。终值利润率为有限期租金减免前口径。不使用通用期限延长或资本正常化。

claims.en: June cash is $822m, debt $39,863m and exact common shares 707,641,531. Finance leases, affiliate equity, other assets, minimum cash, incremental existing awards and other claims require explicit amounts. Affiliate ownership value excludes royalty rights already in core EV; existing awards exclude future SBC cash replacement. Cash below the reserve produces a deduction, not a zero floor.
claims.zh-Hans: 六月现金为 8.22 亿美元，债务 398.63 亿美元，普通股确数为 707,641,531 股。融资租赁、联营股权、其他资产、最低现金、增量既有奖励和其他索偿权均需明确金额。联营所有权价值排除核心 EV 中已有的特许权；既有奖励排除未来股份薪酬现金替代。现金低于储备时继续扣减，不截为零。

funding.en: Conditional common allocation does not certify refinancing, mandatory payments, dividends or buybacks. FY2025 CFO less capex exceeded dividends/buybacks by $15m; H1 2026 was $185m short before other flows. Debt classifications are already included once. No current capital roll-forward, current quote or supported current-target admission is available.
funding.zh-Hans: 条件普通股分配不证明再融资、强制支付、股息或回购有资金支持。2025 年经营现金流减资本支出比股息及回购多 1500 万美元；2026 上半年在其他现金流前缺口 1.85 亿美元。债务分类已仅计入一次。尚无当前资本滚动核对、当前报价或符合条件的当前目标价。

history.en: FY2016–2025 history uses the latest filed comparatives within the cutoff, not ex-ante vintages. GAAP EBIT includes ownership earnings, disposal gains and unusual items excluded or normalized in the core forecast. Refranchising, China/Hong Kong deconsolidation, COVID and 2019 lease accounting limit comparability. CFO less capex is levered FCF, not FCFF. Missing data stays null.
history.zh-Hans: 2016–2025 财年历史使用截止日前最新申报比较数据，并非当时可知版本。GAAP EBIT 包含核心预测中排除或正常化的所有权收益、处置收益及异常事项。再特许经营、中国及香港出表、疫情和 2019 租赁会计影响可比性。经营现金流减资本支出为有杠杆自由现金流，并非 FCFF。缺失数据保持未知。

wacc.en: WACC, normalized tax, terminal growth and incremental ROIC are editable analyst scenarios, not market-calibrated estimates. Bear/base/bull WACC is 9.5%/8%/7%; terminal growth 2%/2.5%/3%; incremental ROIC 13%/18%/22%.
wacc.zh-Hans: WACC、正常化税率、终值增长及增量 ROIC 为可编辑分析者情景，并非市场校准估计。熊市/基准/牛市 WACC 为 9.5%/8%/7%；终值增长为 2%/2.5%/3%；增量 ROIC 为 13%/18%/22%。

tax.en: Normalized cash-tax rates do not extrapolate discrete H1 benefits or appraise every jurisdiction. No deferred-tax asset or speculative refund is added. Unresolved legal and tax claims require a non-overlapping explicit allocation policy.
tax.zh-Hans: 正常化现金税率不外推上半年一次性优惠，也不逐一评估所有税务地区。不增加递延税资产或推测性退税。未解决的法律及税务索偿权需不重复计入的明确分配政策。

uncertainty.en: Simulation is manual and operating-EV only. Fixed initial uncertainty is uncalibrated; every trial uses the same dated annual engine, half-year discounting and terminal normalization. Claims are not jointly sampled, so equity and per-share distributions remain unavailable even after an explicit deterministic illustration. Current target and upside remain unknown.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 模拟需手动运行，且仅提供经营 EV。初始固定不确定性未经校准；每次试验使用同一注明日期的年度引擎、半年折现及终值正常化。未联合抽样索偿权，因此即使选择确定性示例，仍不提供股权及每股分布。当前目标价及上涨空间仍未知。

awards.en: June cash is $822m, debt $39,863m and exact common shares 707,641,531. Finance leases, affiliate equity, other assets, minimum cash, incremental existing awards and other claims require explicit amounts. Affiliate ownership value excludes royalty rights already in core EV; existing awards exclude future SBC cash replacement. Cash below the reserve produces a deduction, not a zero floor.

guidance.en: NEXT rent relief reduces revenue and EBIT once; capital support enters cash capex once. Base 2027–2030 support totals $5bn: $1.75bn capital plus $3.25bn rent relief. A further $3.5bn through 2036 and its 35%/65% split are explicit assumptions. Bear support costs are 20% higher. Do not deduct the program again as a capital claim.
